title: bug: a worktree completion lands on main with no qualityGate when post-flight cannot read .moe/project.json (both wrappers fail open)
description:
Filed by WT-19's whole-epic adversarial review (task-b1ca54f2716442be889a14623eb59983, step 7).

PROBLEM. A worktree completion takes its target and its qualityGate from the wrapper's own post-flight read of .moe/project.json, and that read fails open. A file that is missing, half-written or malformed leaves the defaults in place:
- consolidationBranch '' becomes target main;
- qualityGate '' means no L6 gate;
- the lease follows as git-land-main.
The wrapper never consults the attempt's pinned workspace.target from claim/get_context.

EVIDENCE. Checked on merged tree 88e507e5, which is moe/work-2026-10-24 at 1558f141 plus task-b1ca54f2716442be889a14623eb59983.
- sh: scripts/moe-agent.sh:3087-3088 in read_commit_settings: `except Exception: s = {}`, and `|| parsed=""` after the python call.
- sh: :7729-7730 in land_worktree_completion: `target="${CS_CONSOLIDATION_BRANCH:-main}"` and `QUALITY_GATE="${CS_QUALITY_GATE:-}"`.
- ps1: scripts/moe-agent.ps1:2924, where a missing file skips the read, and :2954-2956, `catch { # Malformed project.json - defaults stand. }`.
- ps1: :7217-7218 in Invoke-MoeWorktreeCompletion, where the target falls back to 'main'.
- The MOE_DISABLE_QUALITY_GATE=1 refusal keys on the configured gate. That gate is also '' after the misread, so the refusal cannot fire.

IMPACT. One bad read breaks rail 1, "with a qualityGate set, no worktree landing skips L6". The completion squash-lands:
- ungated;
- on main instead of the consolidation branch;
- under the wrong lease, so it is not excluded against peers landing on the real target.
The move is still CAS or a non-forced push, so nothing is rewritten. But main in this repo is PR-only (human decision of 2026-11-02), so an ungated landing there needs a human revert. Likelihood is low, but nothing bounds it: a hand edit, a partial write or a read error is enough.

FIX DIRECTION. Change both twins:
- In worktree mode, take the target from the attempt's pinned workspace.target.
- Fail closed. When project.json is missing or unparseable at post-flight, refuse the completion landing with a named code; the bytes stay on moe/task/<taskId> and the next session retries.
- Tell "key absent" (defaults apply) apart from "file unreadable" (refuse).
- Add a scenario for each engine.
definitionOfDone: With .moe/project.json missing or malformed at post-flight, both wrappers refuse the worktree completion landing with a named code: no merge, no push, no git-land-* lease taken, and the bytes stay on moe/task/<taskId>.
The completion target is the attempt's pinned workspace.target when present; a settings value that disagrees is refused or warned, never silently replaced by main.
A postflight-worktree or worktree-landing scenario per engine (sh and ps1) covers the unreadable-settings case, and parity-check.sh / parity-check.ps1 both exit 0.
